text:
Maya (CEO): quick follow-up from today — thanks for the great questions. i want to clarify a few asks on pipeline, demos, and partner handoffs.
Aria (GTM): thanks — could you confirm the priority list for partner-led deals? we had a few asks in the Q&A about which partners get earliest co-sell credits.
Maya (CEO): priority = 1) strategic platform partners (co-sell agreement signed), 2) distributors with enablement program, 3) integration partners by region. we'll publish a short rubric by EOD Fri. :calendar:
Liam (Sales): for partner-led deals, what's the expected demo SKU? small teams want a simple pack to demo in 30m. do we provide demo credentials or a generic sandbox?
Noah (Partnerships): we'll provide a tenant-backed sandbox for strategic partners. for regional distributors it'll be a demo VM image + support doc. Sofia (Product): +1 — Product will bake a "demo-light" SKU (single-model, preset prompts, reduced tokens) for evaluation flows.
Maya (CEO): demo-light SKU is temporary naming, but yes — goal is 30m frictionless demo. we'll limit to 8k context, single model, and constrained tooling to avoid cost surprises.
Aria (GTM): can we get the demo script? Partners asked for a step-by-step runbook.
Sofia (Product): drafting runbook now. example snippet for partner demo scripts:
```
1) Open sandbox at https://sandbox.redwood.example
2) Use demo API key DEMO-XXXX (rotating)
3) Run example prompt: "Summarize product telemetry in 3 bullets"
4) Show streaming responses and token metrics in Console
```
Liam (Sales): will there be an official slide deck + one-pager for reps? short decks help conversion in partner demos.
Aria (GTM): yes — marketing will ship a 1-pager and a short deck next week. target: 1-slide value prop, 1-slide pricing examples, 1-slide integration checklist.
Noah (Partnerships): question about lead routing: when a partner submits a demo lead, does it go to regional AE or partner ops first?
Maya (CEO): routing policy for now: partner ops validates lead -> assigns to regional AE -> if partner is strategic, tag for joint outreach within 24h. we'll codify in the partner portal.
DevBot: Deploy notice: partner-portal v0.9 pushed to staging at 1864129900. :rocket:
Sofia (Product): timeline note — demo-light SKU and runbook beta by Tue next week, partner portal routing rules by Wed.
Liam (Sales): thanks — can we get a quick sync with a few reps to validate the deck next Wed? 20m session.
Aria (GTM): scheduling poll now — will post a Doodle link in #all-hands and ping reps.
Maya (CEO): great. final ask — if folks have follow-ups from today's all-hands pls drop short bullets here or DM me. i want us to ship the partner playbook before end of quarter. :thumbsup:
Noah (Partnerships): adding a note — we need 1 legal template for co-sell addendum. legal team, can you advise on timeline?
Sofia (Product): pinging legal offline, will include legal timeline in the playbook doc.
Aria (GTM): posting the early draft of the rubric and sales play in #product-docs in 30m. feedback welcome. :eyes:
Maya (CEO): thanks everyone. quick wins + actions: 1) demo-light SKU beta (Sofia) 2) runbook + deck (Aria/Marketing) 3) partner routing implement (Engineering/Partner Ops) 4) legal co-sell template (Legal). I'll follow up next Tue.
Liam (Sales): acked.
Noah (Partnerships): ack.
DevBot: Reminder: All-hands follow-up checklist created at 1864130500 (links in #product-docs).
